target.title: Fix Ollama incomplete stream model fallback
target.body:
Closes #100460.

## What Problem This Solves

When Ollama closes a native NDJSON stream before its required final response, the stream adapter emits a deterministic provider error. That error was not classified at the Ollama provider boundary, so the normal model-fallback loop could not advance to the next configured candidate.

## Why This Change Was Made

The final fix keeps provider-specific behavior in the Ollama plugin instead of adding an Ollama literal to the generic agent loop. Both `ollama` and `ollama-cloud` registrations now share one classifier: existing context-window patterns still map to `context_overflow`, while the exact incomplete-stream runtime error maps to `server_error`.

The producer and classifier share one exported constant, preventing message drift. Unrelated Ollama errors remain unclassified.

## User Impact

A prematurely closed Ollama stream can now advance through configured model fallbacks instead of repeatedly failing the same candidate and ending with a generic request failure.

## Evidence

- Existing issue repro: a mock Ollama `/api/chat` returned one incomplete NDJSON chunk and closed; before the fix OpenClaw retried Ollama and never reached fallback, while after the fix it made one Ollama request and returned the fallback response.
- `extensions/ollama/index.test.ts` proves exact incomplete-stream classification for both Ollama provider ids, preserves context-overflow behavior, and rejects unrelated errors.
- `extensions/ollama/src/stream-runtime.test.ts` pins the runtime producer to the shared error contract.
- Exact-head structured AutoReview on `63ca5ba8f31ea3e5e2f9276463d43e1dc52af5f2`: clean, no actionable findings.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`: passed.
- Exact-head hosted CI will be linked after the post-push dispatch selects the changed lanes.
